experiment: Replace the rectangular Bologna control with a pinned, point-refined person instance and neighboring instance protection; compare generic Paint, background-only instruction, and a secondary visual mask reference.

protocol.RAW: Same immutable pre-user-grade linear-calibration native1024square context and fixed shared inverse.
protocol.selection: RT-DETRv2 R18 on actual native Auto source rendering; MobileSAM detector-box proposal refined with manual positive head/coat/bag and negative neighbor/produce points. Two separate instance masks kept. No automated role or independently labeled mask-closure claim.
protocol.conditioning: Selected original detail withheld by native known-boundary harmonic fill. Identical conditioned f32 bytes and binary latent edit mask in all three routes.
protocol.generation: Exact previously pinned Klein4B8bit weights/runtime, strict learned tensor load, seed3941, four steps, guidance1, phase ownership/cache policy and exact decoder block barriers.
protocol.visual_mask_reference: Third route additionally encodes the binary mask as an exact native float RGB secondary VAE reference. No source pixel resampling or u8 source quantization.
protocol.runs: Three fresh reconstruction processes plus one exact generic-route replay after adding the visual-reference option. No additional bake for byte-identical replay.

qualitative_findings.generic: Changes the blue-coated target into another person instead of removing the person.
qualitative_findings.background_only: Still generates a person-shaped replacement despite explicit background-only/no-person wording.
qualitative_findings.visual_mask_reference: Still generates a replacement person; adding exact binary visual mask conditioning does not repair semantic removal on this case.
qualitative_findings.decision: All three configurations fail semantic person removal on this case. Keep Klein unqualified. Previously easier Paint erasure results do not establish a People-removal pass.

scientific_comparison.scope: Unresized native Auto EV0/WB0 source and three reconstructed ROI crops. Qualitative target-removal diagnostic, not a color/noise or hidden-background ground-truth metric.

limitations: No production model admission, app UI/runtime, accepted XMP, asset codec, rendering/export path or native context cap changed.
One public RAW research case; no verified person releases, consented release corpus, independent role labels or hidden-background ground truth.
Refined instance silhouette is visually reviewed, not independent object closure truth. Occluded anatomy, ambiguous touching hands/cuffs, shadows and reflections remain unqualified.
Shared M5 Max128 GiB host; elapsed times are diagnostic and not p50/p95 or supported-device/memory-tier evidence.
No larger native-context, browser/other Apple-device, final accepted-asset, physical noise/detail, transitive-license/conversion/distribution or release qualification.
Adding a visual reference also changes the explanatory prompt; this evaluates that combined protocol, not a claim that the added reference alone caused the output difference.
